title: Wrap app with MemberAuthProvider context

requirements.text: Wrap the root application component tree with MemberAuthProvider from 'frontend/src/hooks/useMemberAuth.tsx' so that member authentication context is available to all pages and components. Since 'frontend/src/main.tsx' is immutable, apply the MemberAuthProvider wrapper inside 'frontend/src/App.tsx' — wrap the RouterProvider (or the top-level JSX returned by App) with <MemberAuthProvider>.
acceptanceCriteria: MemberAuthProvider wraps the entire component tree rendered by App.tsx
The useMemberAuth hook resolves correctly (no 'used outside provider' errors) in Login, MemberDashboard, and Navigation components
All existing routes continue to render without errors
Member login and logout flows work as before

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/main.tsx — it is immutable
Import MemberAuthProvider from the existing 'frontend/src/hooks/useMemberAuth.tsx', not from a new file
nonGoals: Creating a new MemberAuthContext file — the existing useMemberAuth.tsx already exports MemberAuthProvider
Changing any authentication logic or backend calls
Modifying any page or component other than App.tsx
